limitations.note: Bundling a blocked cleanup command with the edit and test prevented the whole batch from running, so the agent had to resubmit it with a different cleanup method.

The fix matches the reference for binary inputs, but in four-state simulation it can assign X to `match` when the comparison is indeterminate, whereas the original and reference `if/else` drive it low.
